project_type: Next.js 16 App Router web app (React 19, TypeScript 6) with Leaflet + React-Leaflet mapping and Turf.js geo. Two routes: '/' (AreaPicker landing) and '/explore' (Dashboard with streaming Overpass data).
build_system: npm scripts; Tailwind CSS v4 compiled via @tailwindcss/postcss. No bundler config beyond Next.js defaults. `next build` is the production build; `tsc --noEmit` is the type checker; `eslint .` is the linter. Shell is PowerShell on Windows — use `;` as command separator, not `&&`.
test_framework: None configured. `package.json` has `typecheck`, `lint`, `build`, `dev`, `start` only — no `test` script.
test_command: npm run typecheck ; npm run lint
verification_instructions: Run from the repo root 'c:\Users\Daniyal\Desktop\New folder\Alethiea' in PowerShell: `npm run typecheck ; npm run lint`. For final sign-off also run `npm run build`. All three must exit 0 with no new warnings. Then exercise DESIGN.md § 4.4 functional checklist manually at 375 / 768 / 1440 px: (1) '/': place search, preset buttons, size selector 1x1/2x2/3x3, 'Analyse this area' navigates to '/explore?lat=&lng=&size=&label='; (2) '/explore': streaming progress visible, map grid renders, cell click selects + opens inspector, 'Propose 150m' creates scenario, ImpactComparison renders, StatusPill transitions streaming -> ready, Header 'Change area' returns to '/' and the pill resets to idle; (3) mobile <768: MobileNavDrawer opens/closes/traps focus/Esc, MobileExploreTabs switches Map ↔ Priority ↔ Inspector, auto-switch to Inspector exactly once per area on first selection and once on first proposal; (4) prefers-reduced-motion: all .animate-* become no-ops and ImpactComparison scrollIntoView uses behavior:'auto'.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. There are no generated artifacts to check in. `public/` is static assets only; `scripts/fetch-osm.mjs` is a developer convenience and is not run by the build.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell: use `;` as the command separator in shell commands, not `&&`. Never run `next dev` as part of verification; it would rewrite the AGENTS.md block. The AGENTS.md note is maintained by Next.js itself — leave it alone. Use absolute paths or an explicit cwd of 'c:\Users\Daniyal\Desktop\New folder\Alethiea' for every npm command.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md says: this is Next.js 16; APIs and conventions may differ from training data; read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before making framework-level changes. For this task, the framework-level change is minimal: layout.tsx wraps children in a client Provider. The layout stays a server component; the Provider carries the 'use client' boundary.
key_patterns: Styling is Tailwind v4 utilities + a few hand-written utilities in src/app/globals.css. Existing animation keyframes (fade-in, slide-up, slide-down, shimmer, float, glow-pulse, gradient-shift, pop-in) are already gated by `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)` with no-op overrides under `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`. All new keyframes/utilities MUST live inside those same gates. Priority band color is owned by `priorityBand(cell.priority).color` from `src/lib/scoring.ts` (off-limits) and must continue to drive polygon fill. Dashboard's streaming state is partitioned by `requestKey = `${query}#${reloadKey}`` so switching areas resets everything without an effect writing state synchronously — keep this pattern intact. Leaflet is mounted via `next/dynamic` with `ssr: false` in MapShell.tsx; MapContainer must never mount twice simultaneously (single-mount invariant).
